title: A nondegenerate continuous C0(T)-algebra over a locally compact Hausdorff base, with a fibre-preserving strongly continuous symplectic-vector-group action, remains a covariant continuous field under fixed Rieffel deformation, with each fibre canonically deformed
author: Fabian Belmonte; Marius Mantoiu
work: Covariant Fields of C*-Algebras under Rieffel Deformation
source_version: Official SIGMA 8 (2012) article 091, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2012.091; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof must preserve the nondegenerate central base action through a multiplier-algebra deformation, which requires Dixmier-Malliavin factorization and explicit smooth-ideal regularization estimates. It then identifies the deformed fibre ideals and proves lower semicontinuity through invariant primitive-ideal hulls and openness, substantive noncommutative topology and analysis beyond ordinary qualification C-star theory.

proof_review.note: Full Theorem1.1 in the actual Section2 setting of a finite-dimensional symplectic vector group Xi=R^(2n), with a fixed nondegenerate skew form, is selected. Read all Rieffel smooth-Frechet/exactness preliminaries, C(T)=C0(T) field/nondegeneracy definitions, complete Lemma4.2 smooth-ideal density proof with integrated-action derivative estimates and Dixmier-Malliavin finite factorization, all Theorem4.3 multiplier/centrality/nondegeneracy construction, Proposition4.4 exact identification of fibre ideals, and full Proposition5.1 primitive-hull/openness argument. Standard Rieffel deformation/exactness, Dauns-Hoffman and continuous-field primitive-space criteria are explicitly prior published background; no unexpanded new local core is cited in place of a proof. The action fixes the base and preserves all fibre ideals. No continuity in a varying deformation parameter, arbitrary noncovariant field, degenerate skew form, quantum-group example or separate semicontinuity/helper count is asserted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem1.1 under the paper Section2-4 standing data: T locally compact Hausdorff, A possibly nonunital C-star algebra, Q:C0(T)->ZM(A) injective and nondegenerate, nonzero fibres A(t), and continuous fibre-norm functions vanishing at infinity. Xi=R^(2n) carries a fixed nondegenerate symplectic form and acts strongly continuously on A by automorphisms; covariance is Theta_X(Q(phi)a)=Q(phi)Theta_X(a), equivalently every fibre ideal invariant. Rieffel deformation gives the nondegenerate covariant C0(T)-algebra A_deformed with continuous field and fibres canonically equal to the individual deformations of A(t). The parameter/form is fixed; no analytic family in Planck constant or noncovariant/degenerate-form extension is selected.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Source annotation only: Lemma4.2 final regularization integral writes Theta_X with integration variable Y; its preceding definition of Theta_Phi and final equality identify the integrated action. Proposition5.1 abbreviates the quantized base-map range as Z(A), whereas the explicitly constructed map in Theorem4.3 and all field definitions use ZM(A), including nonunital algebras. Source prose and formulas remain unchanged; the selected theorem uses that defined central multiplier map.
